evidence_candidates.source_locator: operation schedule and data migration sections
evidence_candidates.excerpt: The center scheduled TSUBAME4 service from April 2024 and kept TSUBAME3 storage online through June for download. Data and accounts were not automatically inherited, and remaining data would be deleted after the window.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: TSUBAME4 used an explicit three-month storage-only migration window with no automatic data inheritance.
